auth_details: No authentication required for public ABS.Stat open data endpoints; requests are unauthenticated HTTPS GETs.
free_tier_limits: Public open data; no charge for standard API use (fair-use / capacity limits may apply)
description: Official Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS.Stat) web services expose economic, demographic, labour, and census datasets via SDMX-JSON (and related) REST endpoints at data.api.abs.gov.au. Developers query dataflows, structure, and observations without an API key for public open data use cases.
resolution_notes: base_url: Auditor correct — official docs (abs.gov.au APIs page, 2024-11-29 change) and live probes show current REST root is https://data.api.abs.gov.au/rest; old api.data.abs.gov.au is retired. example: Auditor correct — rebuilt with current host/path and CPI_Q dataflow (version omitted for latest); response uses current SDMX-JSON meta/data envelope. Evidence: https://www.abs.gov.au/about/data-services/application-programming-interfaces-apis and https://data.api.abs.gov.au/rest
